page.title: Document expiry
page.lead: Every document that expires — and every one that is missing: what is valid today, when it needs renewal and which process stops.

load.error: The registry could not be loaded.

stateHint.missing: No file, no declaration and no review approval — and a running process requires it.
stateHint.expiring: It is within the time its kind needs for renewal.
stateHint.expiry-unknown: We do not know until when it is valid — it is not treated as valid.
stateHint.valid: Valid and not yet due for renewal.
stateHint.superseded: A newer document of the same kind replaced it.

row.declared: Declared on the property, no file
row.undeclared: No details — issue and expiry dates have not been entered. Fill them in from the document itself
row.expiryUnknown: Unknown — the issue date is missing or the validity of this kind is not verified
row.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {expires today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}
row.daysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
row.sourceRule: from the rule for this kind
row.sourceFloor: at least — the printed expiry has not been entered

undesignated.no-majority: No responsible owner set — nobody holds a majority share
undesignated.unknown-shares: No responsible owner set — the shares are not known

lead.stale: The choice “{name}” no longer applies: not an owner
lead.onePerProperty: One document for the whole property — request it only from the responsible owner.
lead.onePerPropertyUndesignated: One document for the whole property — set a responsible owner so you ask only one person.

nextStep.heading: Next step
nextStep.findProfessionalNear: In the property's area — only those who can issue it.
nextStep.findProfessionalAnywhere: The property's area is not known: the directory opens for all of Greece — pick an area there.
nextStep.selfServiceHint: Online, the same day, with the obligor's Taxisnet credentials.
nextStep.opensInNewTab: Opens the official page in a new tab

path.aade-tax-clearance: Applications → Tax Services → Tax clearance → Issue certificate

dependents.heading: What stops if it expires
dependents.none: No open process needs it today.
dependents.continuous: for as long as it stays published
dependents.undetermined: cannot be judged — the expiry is unknown
dependents.undeterminedDay: cannot be judged — no signing date has been set
dependents.absent: without a valid document as of today

truncated.title: The registry is incomplete
truncated.body: These reached the read limit and not everything is shown: {sources}. The counts cover only what was read.
truncated.owner-properties: privately owned properties under a mandate

empty.title: No expiring documents found
empty.hint: Import the energy certificate from the property's “Documents” tab — the issue and expiry dates are read from the document itself.

scope.note: Not in the registry: the personal space and documents sent by third parties (transmittals).
scope.unscopedListings: {count, plural, =0 {Every listing under the office name was checked.} one {# listing under the office name is not checked: the office is not its custodian.} other {# listings under the office name are not checked: the office is not their custodian.}}

leadPicker.title: Responsible owner for property documents
leadPicker.description: One owner takes care of the energy certificate and building identity for the whole property. The others remain co-owners.
leadPicker.automaticHint: Majority share or principal seller, when there is one — otherwise nobody.

error.failed: The responsible owner was not saved. Please try again.
error.notAnOwner: This contact is no longer an owner of the property.
error.ownersUnknown: The owners could not be read right now — please try again shortly.
error.notFound: The property was not found in the office registry.

issuance.heading: Issuance assignment
issuance.assignHint: To a professional the office already knows. The office proposes; the owner decides.
issuance.unavailable: Assignments could not be read right now — refresh the page before assigning, so that two documents are not issued.
issuance.credentialWithNumber: {qualification} · registry no. {number} — declared by the office
issuance.lastFulfilled: The previous document was assigned to {name} and issued.
issuance.lastClosed: The previous proposal ({name}) closed without an assignment.

stage.ownerApproved: Approved by the owner — notify the professional
stage.declined: The professional declined — propose someone else

propose.title: Issuance assignment: {document}
propose.description: The owner appoints the professional. The office proposes — nothing is sent to anyone before the owner's decision is recorded.
propose.noKnown: No known professional for this document yet — pick a contact or find a professional.
propose.previously: {count, plural, one {# assignment} other {# assignments}} approved by owners · latest {date}
propose.declared: The office declares the qualification — the app does not verify it. Only the qualifications the law allows for this document are listed.

decision.title: Owner decision
decision.description: You are recording the decision of the responsible owner ({name}). The app sends no message to anyone.
decision.needsLead: Designate a responsible owner first: the decision for a whole-property document belongs to one person.

notice.title: Notify the professional
notice.description: Record how {name} was notified. The app sends no message.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel assignment
cancelDialog.description: The assignment closes and is recorded in the property history. If the professional was already notified, let them know too.

error.failed: The assignment was not saved. Please try again.
error.notFound: The document no longer needs an assignment, or the property is not in the office's registry.
error.unavailable: Assignments could not be read right now — please try again shortly.
error.contactUnavailable: The contact is not available to the office.
error.unqualified: This qualification cannot issue this document.
error.leadUndesignated: No responsible owner is designated — designate one first.
error.leadChanged: The responsible owner changed in the meantime. Review and record again.
error.stale: The assignment changed in the meantime — see its current state.
error.transitionRefused: This action is not allowed at this stage of the assignment.
error.actorRefused: The action was not accepted — please start again.
error.noEmail: The recipient has no email in their contact. Add one, or record the answer manually.
error.coOwnerUnknown: One of the selected co-owners can no longer be informed. Reopen the dialog.
error.linksUnavailable: Links are unavailable right now — nothing was sent.

send.ownerTitle: Send for approval to the responsible owner
send.professionalTitle: Send the assignment to the professional
send.ownerDescription: {name} will receive an email with a personal link to approve or reject, without an account. The link expires in 7 days.
send.professionalDescription: {name} will receive an email with a personal link to accept or decline, without an account. The link expires in 7 days.
send.coOwnersLegend: Inform co-owners (a separate message to each, without a decision link)
send.never: Nothing is sent until you press “Send”. The personal link is added at the moment of sending; if you resend, the previous one stops working.
send.sent: The message was accepted for sending.
send.notDelivered: The send was recorded, but the email did not go out. Resend, or record the answer manually.
send.accessCodeHint: The link will also ask for a 6-digit code that you give by phone, so a forwarded email is not enough for someone else to answer.
send.codeBody: Give it by phone — not by email. It will not be shown again; if it is lost, send again (the previous link stops working). After 5 wrong codes the link locks and you are notified.
send.remindersLabel: Automatic reminders if there is no answer
send.remindersHint: A reminder {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} later and on the day before the link expires, during office hours. The access code is never re-sent. They stop as soon as there is an answer or if the email bounces.

history.informed: {count, plural, one {# co-owner informed} other {# co-owners informed}}
history.notDelivered: The email did not go out — resend.
history.noticedByLink: Sent to the professional with a link on {date}
history.acceptedByLink: The professional accepted through the link on {date}
history.declinedByLink: The professional declined through the link on {date}
history.bounced: The email bounced — check the contact’s address and send again.
history.complained: The recipient marked it as spam — contact them by phone.

factsDeclaration.title: Document details
factsDeclaration.description: Enter what the document itself states. The expiry is checked against the legal limits of its kind.
factsDeclaration.classificationSuggested: Suggested from the property type — choose the category the author states on the document.

classification.C: C — entertainment or public assembly premises, outdoor installation

error.failed: The details were not saved. Please try again.
error.absent: The file was not found — it may have been deleted.
error.kindNotPromised: The file was not uploaded as this kind of document.
error.notThisObject: A new version of the file was uploaded meanwhile. Close and reopen to see it.
error.outranked: The details were read from the document itself or approved in the conveyance review — correct them there.
error.notPrinted: This kind of document does not print an expiry date — the expiry is computed from the issue date.
error.validityBeforeIssue: The expiry is before the issue date.
error.classificationInvalid: This category does not apply to this kind of document.
